note: Thresholds are set by the athlete, not by the agent or its developer. A rule whose value is null is reported as not_configured on every run; it never passes silently.

R1_hrv_drop.description: HRV more than X% below its 7-day baseline: no hard session

R2_short_sleep.description: Slept less than X hours: no hard session

R3_elevated_rhr.description: Resting HR more than X bpm above its 7-day baseline: easy session or rest

R4_fatigue.description: Form (TSB) below X: easy session or rest

R5_load_ramp.description: Last 7 days' load more than X% above the previous 7 days: no hard session

R6_rest_overdue.description: X or more consecutive days without rest: rest or easy session

R7_duration_cap.description: Proposed duration at most X times the planned duration

R8_weather.description: Rain above X mm or gusts above Y km/h: no outdoor bike

R9_missing_data.description: HRV, resting HR or sleep missing today: intensity at most X (easy or moderate)

R10_planned_rest.description: A planned rest day stays a rest day (true/false)
